source: Verified upstream GitHub repositories and immutable commits
purpose: Isolated, reproducible reference sources for LiveLens architecture. No vendored code is part of the runtime.
source_policy: research-only until tests, security audit and licensing approval

items.role: End-to-end Node.js recording, chat JSONL, auto-record, replay and UI reference
items.risk: Small, lightly adopted project; unofficial access; marketing claims including 'stealth' are not verified. No code executed.

items.role: Python monitoring loops, recorder stability and recovery design reference
items.risk: No licence file or GitHub licence metadata detected at pinned revision. Do not copy into production without an explicit licence/permission.

items.role: Mature Python FFmpeg recording reference; compare media stability and file finalisation
items.risk: No live-source reliability test performed. Review requests, network, cookies and FFmpeg invocation before reusing.

items.role: Alternative Python live-event and caption adapter
items.risk: Custom additional licence clauses; inspect actual LICENSE and commercial/service implications. Unofficial upstream.

items.role: Preferred candidate for independent real-time speech-to-text and diarisation benchmark
items.risk: Resource-heavy optional models and separate model licences; require isolated GPU/CPU benchmark before deployment.

items.role: Optional input to content-risk triage, never automatic verdict
items.risk: Model errors, dialect bias, model-weight terms and failure to understand jokes/context. Needs human review.

items.role: Existing Community Manager's event integration family; evaluate protocols and stability
items.risk: Modified AGPL with extra clauses; licensing review required before distributing or running commercial service. Unofficial API.

items.role: Compare speaker diarisation accuracy and overlap handling against WhisperLiveKit backends
items.risk: Source code MIT but model checkpoints may have access conditions and distinct usage terms.
